reason: One feature crosses migration, sqlc queries, handler contract, the daemon claim payload, the CLI, core schema/client, views UI and four locale bundles — a change is only correct if every layer agrees.

The template flow must go through the existing CreateAgent path (runtime access, thinking/tier validation, name conflict, invocation permission) instead of forking a parallel creation route, and must reuse createSkillWithFilesInTx for materialization.
